description: This file contains helper methods for analyzing C# syntax trees, including attribute handling, member inspection, and type/interface inheritance checks, specifically tailored for Orleans grain interfaces and classes.

classes.name: SyntaxHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for analyzing and extracting information from C# syntax nodes, especially attributes, members, and inheritance relationships within the Roslyn compiler API context.

methods.name: TryGetTypeName
methods.description: Attempts to extract the type name from an AttributeSyntax node.

methods.name: IsAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an AttributeSyntax node matches a given attribute name, considering possible suffix 'Attribute'.

methods.name: HasAttribute
methods.description: Determines if a member declaration has a specific attribute applied.

methods.name: TryGetAttribute
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a specific attribute from a member declaration.

methods.name: GetMemberNameOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the name of a member (property or field), or null if not applicable.

methods.name: IsAbstract
methods.description: Checks if a member is marked as abstract.

methods.name: IsStatic
methods.description: Checks if a member is marked as static.

methods.name: HasModifier
methods.description: Checks if a member has a specific modifier.

methods.name: IsInstanceMember
methods.description: Determines if a member is an instance member (not static or const).

methods.name: IsFieldOrAutoProperty
methods.description: Checks if a member is a field or an auto-implemented property.

methods.name: ExtendsGrainInterface
methods.description: Checks if an interface extends the Orleans grain interface.

methods.name: InheritsGrainClass
methods.description: Checks if a class inherits from the Orleans grain base class.

methods.name: GetArgumentBag
methods.description: Extracts a typed argument value from an attribute's argument list.

methods.name: GetAttributeSyntaxes
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute syntaxes matching a given attribute name.

methods.name: GetArgumentValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of the first argument of an attribute.
